exposure: Age groups: <20 years, 20-24 years, 25-29 years, 30-34 years, 35-39 years, 40+ years
Women educated below the secondary level
Education level: below secondary, secondary or higher
cohort: Sudanese women attending Saad Abuelela Tertiary Hospital in Khartoum, Sudan, from February to December 2019
finding: The risk of miscarriage among Sudanese women followed a unique curve in relation to maternal age, with lower risk for women under 20 and at 40 years old; high parity, caesarean delivery history, and obesity were also risk factors.
